name: Being Self Centered
overview: Scripture reveals that being self-centered leads to defilement and destructive behavior, as what proceeds from the heart contaminates the person (Mark 7:20). The believer is called to crucify the self and live by faith in Christ, who indwells and transforms (Galatians 2:20). This transformation manifests in speech that builds others up rather than tearing them down (Ephesians 4:29) and in a heart that rejects bitterness, anger, and malice (Ephesians 4:31). True humility requires esteeming others above oneself, avoiding selfish ambition and strife, which only produce confusion and evil works (Philippians 2:3; James 3:16).
